description.value: Established in 1992, Sharkey's is a long-standing Ladner waterfront institution known for fish and chips, gourmet burgers, and craft beer in an east coast-style setting. Its award-winning waterfront patio makes it a natural stopping point for cyclists touring the South Delta flatlands along the Fraser delta. The family-friendly atmosphere and broad menu — from clam chowder and seafood fettuccine to kids' meals — cater to groups of all sizes.
